genuine_additions.question: After all players have finished their Reveal turns, a Combat Intrigue changes a participant's deployed units or strength while that participant still has a unit in the Conflict. Must their Combat marker change during the Combat Intrigue window, or does the Reveal-turn value stay fixed until cleanup? Which strength is used to determine Conflict rewards?
genuine_additions.expected_answer: Adjust the participant's Combat marker on the Combat track to reflect the changed units or strength when the card resolves. Their Reveal-turn total is not fixed for the rest of the round. Resolve Combat after all involved players pass consecutively, using the adjusted strength shown on the track for rewards. If a later effect removes their last unit, their strength becomes zero.
genuine_additions.novelty: Main p14 explicitly prescribes an ongoing phase-3 update after strength was set during Reveal. Q08 asks pass/re-entry/closure and post-reward unit destinations; its key alone says adjust strength for effects, which receives no coverage credit. Q71 asks updates during the Reveal turn, not during Combat. Q07 asks the unit/sword formula and last-unit-zero exception, not maintaining a nonzero participant's marker after a Combat Intrigue resolves. Q69 asks only the separate automatic Rival bonus. Q91 asks reset after rewards. The new claim is this consequential Combat-window timing/procedure; the final-unit-zero and consecutive-pass reminders are repeated context only. No named-card or changed-number variant is proposed.
